product_objective: Make experiment learnings evidence-bound, reviewable, and reusable by the next agent, then validate that workflow with Pioneer.

phases.research_question: Which governed Claim Graph disclosure mechanism best supports native APEX work?
phases.product_connection: Select the default interface by which a successor agent receives governed knowledge.
phases.hypothesis: A small governed seed with model-directed traversal and gap search will outperform large static disclosure.
phases.protocol: Twelve native APEX tasks; Governed RAG, small-seed open loop, and claim-plus-source; DeepSeek and GPT-5.6 executors; blind native grading.
success_criteria: Preserve no-admission and Human Approval boundaries
stop_rules: Do not infer universal model superiority
Do not treat staged grader output as lawyer approval
phases.observed_outcome: Small-seed open loop was the strongest mechanism for DeepSeek and directionally strongest for GPT-5.6, with lower context than governed disclosure.
phases.decision: Keep small-seed progressive disclosure as the current executor default.
phases.next_action: Diagnose the zero-heavy tasks without assuming that more context or more tool calls is the solution.

phases.research_question: Do uncapped graph discovery or raw-corpus access solve the five zero-heavy exact tasks?
phases.product_connection: Determine whether the Claim Graph interface needs more retrieval breadth or more precise governed objects.
phases.hypothesis: Removing discovery caps will improve exact-task success.
phases.protocol: Five zero-heavy native APEX tasks; small-seed, governed open discovery, and raw-corpus access; GPT-5.6, DeepSeek, and GLM.
success_criteria: Attribute failures by requirement and graph coverage
stop_rules: Stop retrieval tuning if graph sufficiency dominates failures
Do not promote model-specific directional effects
phases.observed_outcome: Small-seed scored 8.89%, governed open discovery 1.48%, and raw-corpus access 5.43%; requirement coverage and graph sufficiency dominated.
phases.decision: Do not increase discovery breadth; build exact evidence, authority, and derivation primitives.
phases.next_action: Compile atomic requirements into typed completion paths before another executor comparison.

phases.research_question: Can Proofpress construct stable, source-bound numeric atoms, table cells, authority candidates, and deterministic derivations?
phases.product_connection: Provide generic exact experiment evidence for the hosted Pioneer profile without changing governance semantics.
phases.hypothesis: Requirement-aware exact primitives can close representation gaps that broader retrieval did not close.
phases.protocol: Construction-only Stage A and Stage B checkpoints over five development tasks, followed by v19-v24 deterministic table-cell and derivation stabilization; no answer executor.
success_criteria: Explicit gaps instead of invented closure
stop_rules: Do not run an answer executor before substrate readiness
Do not treat candidate coverage as legal quality
Freeze rather than keep fitting the five development tasks
phases.observed_outcome: Typed numeric atoms, generic table cells, and mixed deterministic derivations were implemented; v23-v24 agreed on 48 of 49 slot states; no object was admitted.
phases.decision: Merge PR61 as a generic exact-evidence substrate and keep APEX/legal machinery as research adapters.
phases.next_action: Use the merged experiment profile and hosted control plane to dogfood the real R&D lineage.

phases.research_question: Do static exact primitives improve native task success over static ordinary claims?
phases.product_connection: Attempted representation ablation, but it did not match the product-facing small-seed interface selected in PR55.
phases.hypothesis: Adding table cells and derivations to a static claim projection will improve native success.
phases.protocol: Three development tasks; ordinary static claims versus static claims plus numeric atoms, table cells, and derivations; DeepSeek executor and native Gemini grader.
success_criteria: Both paired cells submit final answers
stop_rules: Stop after lineage review finds protocol misalignment
Do not expand an inconclusive development diagnostic
phases.observed_outcome: Two of six cells were attempted: ordinary completed at 0.0; exact timed out without a grade; known cost was $0.32802352.
phases.decision: Abort the diagnostic as protocol-misaligned and inconclusive, not as evidence against the small-seed Claim Graph mechanism.
phases.next_action: Do not rerun; move the product path to hosted R&D lineage dogfood.

failure.intervention: Run a static ordinary-claim versus static exact-evidence native diagnostic.
failure.expected_outcome: Both conditions converge and isolate the contribution of exact primitives.
failure.feedback: The exact cell did not submit within 30 minutes, and lineage review showed that the protocol omitted the selected small-seed agentic interface.
invalidated_hypotheses: This reduced static diagnostic is the next product-facing experiment
More unrestricted native exploration is sufficient for convergence
failure.changed_dimension_required: Use the same small-seed interface in both arms and add a synthesis checkpoint

phases.research_question: Can Proofpress itself prevent protocol drift and repeated R&D work by governing experiment blueprints, outcomes, failures, and supersession?
phases.product_connection: This is the direct internal rehearsal for the Pioneer experiment-learning POC.
phases.hypothesis: A successor agent that reads admitted blueprint and failed-attempt records will recover the current objective without reconstructing PR and Notion history.
phases.protocol: Compile this content-addressed lineage into Richard Personal Hosted as bounded evidence and reviewable experiment decisions; keep all records pending until Richard reviews them; then test successor-agent retrieval.
success_criteria: Every phase is source-bound and reviewable
Aborted work is a structured failed attempt
A successor agent recovers the active objective from admitted context
stop_rules: Do not upload raw prompts, private APEX content, or credentials
Do not make APEX completion a Pioneer delivery gate
phases.observed_outcome: Implementation is active; no cloud lineage record is admitted yet.
phases.decision: Use the hosted experiment profile as the canonical governed R&D handoff instead of relying on narrative reconstruction alone.
phases.next_action: Upload these five candidates to Richard Personal Hosted, review them in the owner surface, and verify successor-agent context.
